steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each measure is placed by its group size against the minimum of five, and whether it has a source.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 measure is reported for a group below the minimum

findings.title: Measure reported for a group below the minimum size
findings.fix: Merge the group or drop the measure

findings.title: Measure with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the measure

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] measure-age.csv:12  Measure reported for a group below the minimum size.
       Fix: Merge the group or drop the measure.
[medium] measure-ethnicity.csv:19  Measure with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the measure.
[low] source-list.md:26  Goal with no target date.
       Fix: Set the target date.
Not checked: Causes beyond the data.
pros: Checks a measure below the minimum group size, a measure with no source, and a goal with no target date.
cons: Not checked: Causes beyond the data.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-dei-report skill on the records for this review.
